query: SELECT id AS "id!", template_id AS "template_id!", at AS "at!" FROM ( (SELECT o.id, o.template_id, coalesce((SELECT min(d.received_at) FROM messaging.delivery_event d WHERE d.provider_sid = o.provider_sid AND d.status = 'delivered'), o.sent_at, o.created_at) AS at, o.created_at AS queued, 0 AS rank FROM messaging.outbox o WHERE o.recipient_id = $1 AND $2 = ANY(o.subject_ids) AND o.template_id = ANY($3::text[]) AND o.status NOT IN ('blocked', 'failed', 'expired') ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT e.id, substr(e.template_id, length($4) + 1), coalesce(e.sent_at, e.queued_at), e.queued_at, 1 FROM messaging.email_outbox e WHERE e.recipient_id = $1 AND $2 = ANY(e.subject_ids) AND substr(e.template_id, length($4) + 1) = ANY($3::text[]) AND starts_with(e.template_id, $4) AND e.status <> 'dropped' ORDER BY e.queued_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1) ) told ORDER BY queued DESC, rank ASC LIMIT 1
